scope: Spain mainland priority; islands lower priority and not a blocker, per user steering. Not restricted to Catalonia.
method: Remote GDAL 1x1 windows via HTTP range requests to three public COGs. No full map download, training, runner or operational changes. Three Catalan test sites, not Spain-wide validation.

comparison_limitations: Mean vs median are different estimates; choosing a different statistic alone does not establish greater accuracy.
OpenLandMap top layer is0–30cm; current SoilGrids preview0–5cm. No direct replacement or mixing horizons.
OpenLandMap intervals are68% at120m vs SoilGrids90% at250m; smaller interval widths are not directly comparable evidence of improved accuracy.
Greater spatial resolution does not establish site-level accuracy; no measured pH at these sites.
Known aereus and caesarea occurrence supports investigating omitted species; does not itself measure pH or validate either model.
Global coverage advertised excluding deserts/permanent ice; effective mainland Spain coverage/NoData not yet audited.
Even the alternative intervals partially overlap current species windows, so simply replacing the data would not fix hiding uncertain species under the current policy.
esdac_assessment: European pH in H2O and CaCl2 maps at500m from LUCAS2009/2012. Useful comparison candidate, not finer spatial detail. Requires request/registration; no request submitted.
next_step: Compare equivalent depths/statistics and more mainland reference points before selecting a source; retain uncertainty and preserve editable provisional species ranges.

sporas_user_reported_comparison.source: User reports Sporas pH 6.6 for Olvan and 7.1 for Merles; not independently queried from Sporas API. Exact coincidence of Sporas query coordinates not verified.
sporas_user_reported_comparison.interpretation: Better agreement with the reported Sporas values, especially Olvan. Agreement between estimates does not establish measured soil pH or identify the Sporas source.

whole_soilgrids_replacement_review.user_preference: Minimize distinct soil data sources where equivalent inputs exist. This is a feasibility inquiry, not authorization for a general migration.
whole_soilgrids_replacement_review.assessment: OpenLandMap is not pH-only, but the inspected30m soildb product lacks our water retention inputs. Legacy250m water products do not establish a drop-in replacement:10kPa missing from documented list, depth points differ from intervals, and matching uncertainty quantiles unverified. Using legacy layers would still combine different products even under one provider.
whole_soilgrids_replacement_review.recommendation: Evaluate OpenLandMap pH while retaining existing SoilGrids water data. A full unification requires separate scientific/contract validation and is not needed to test the pH improvement. No change to data sources, downloads or water engine.
